questionText: How do you configure component scanning to include additional packages?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can configure two component scan roots safely and knows which related package searches are unaffected.

claims.statement: SpringBootApplication exposes scanBasePackages and the type-safe scanBasePackageClasses alternative as aliases for component-scan package attributes.
For each class supplied to scanBasePackageClasses, Spring scans the package containing that class, and a no-op marker type is an intended use.
SpringBootApplication component scan base settings have no effect on JPA entity scanning or Spring Data repository scanning.

examples.title: Application class and shared marker class define two scan roots

validation.command: mvn -o -q test in a temporary Spring Boot 3.3.1 harness; typeSafeRootsKeepTheApplicationPackageAndAddTheSharedPackage
validation.expected: ApplicationContext starts and contains sharedService from the second package root

visuals.title: String and type-safe scan root choices

notes: The example deliberately includes BookstoreApplication.class because explicit base-package values replace the no-value package default.
